page.overview:
Who is Lula Burch?

Lula Burch is a Gangrel antitribu and a member of The Dead Gypsies, a nomadic Sabbat pack.

Born and raised in the farm country of Arkansas, Lula lived a very quiet life. A loner by choice, she spent most of her free time reading and thinking. Her mortal life ended the night she awoke to find a strange man in her room. Having watched her for weeks, the pack's ductus, Harry Reese, decided her beauty and inner strength made her a worthy candidate to become his undead lover.

Before she could even scream, Lula was whisked away to the same cemetery where her grandparents and generations of her ancestors were buried. The Dead Gypsies subjected her to the Creation Rites. She nominally proved herself soon after during a battle against a fierce Lupine—though in truth, she did absolutely nothing during the fight; another recruit actually killed the werewolf and was destroyed in the process. Having been a vampire for only two years, Lula is still slowly adjusting to her harsh new unlife on the road.

Equipment: Colt Python, collection of books
